# Outlier

> Mac-native local AI runtime with a custom paged Mixture-of-
> Experts inference engine. Runs frontier-scale models like
> Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 64GB Apple Silicon Macs by streaming
> expert weights off SSD. Offline, no API tokens, no usage caps.
> Includes an agent loop (plan / act / verify /
> recover), MCP connectors, Projects, Code Agent v2, and six model
> tiers from 4B to 397B.

## Pricing
- Requirements: M1 or newer · macOS 15+ (free update)
- Free: Nano 4B + Lite 9B, no account, no token bill
- Pro: unlocked by a one-time purchase, not a subscription - all six tiers including Plus 397B, Marathon mode, Computer use, Deep Research, context up to 128K tokens (Free: 8K). $49 once, activates on up to 3 Macs, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Outlier Lifetime Licence, Black Friday price: all of November, until 2026-12-01 07:59 UTC (the end of 30 November, US time), everyone pays $24.50 once; from 1 December it's $49 - the Buy button applies the code FOUNDINGOUTLIER for you at checkout (if the checkout shows $49, enter it under "Have a discount code?") - everything Pro includes for the lifetime of the Outlier product, including future model releases. If Outlier is ever sunset, licence holders get 90 days' notice and a final release.

## Who makes Outlier
Outlier is made by Kerr & Company (https://kerrandcompanyholdings.com/), a small studio in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The same studio makes Crisp Video (offline video restore for Mac), Docket SEO (website audits), AdPlaybook (ad campaigns from a product page) and BookBreaker (sports betting odds for Mac).
